claims: RTX 5070 FP16 Tensor Core with FP32 accumulation: 61.7 dense, 123.5 sparse-effective TFLOP/s.
FP16 accumulation instead gives 123.5 dense TFLOP/s; this is a different numerical contract.
987.8 FP4 sparse-effective TOPS rounds to the product page's 988 AI TOPS.
Peak rates are based on GPU Boost clock. Slash second values use sparsity.

sources.title: Convolutional Layers User's Guide
claims: cuDNN provides implicit-GEMM and transform (FFT/Winograd) convolution families.
Implicit GEMM forms the convolution matrices virtually without materializing full im2col matrices.
Tensor Core convolution may need NCHW-to-NHWC transforms; small or poorly tiled dimensions lose efficiency.
Dilation does not increase the nominal GEMM dimensions; layout and implementation still affect performance.
